segments.name: restaurant operations
products: sales of food ingredients and condiments
segments.description: Operates Chicken Claypot House and Zi Wei Yuan hotpot restaurants in Malaysia, selling meals, food ingredients and franchise licenses.
segments.evidence: The single reportable segment is restaurant operations, among which revenues from company-owned restaurants are considered as the primary revenue source, while sales of food ingredients and condiments, franchise licensing are diversified revenue contributions dependent upon the Group's brand influence.

revenueModel.text: Diners pay for meals at company-owned restaurants, distributors and franchisees buy food ingredients and condiments, and franchisees pay for franchise licensing.
revenueModel.evidence: a general trader since we are involved in the business of selling food ingredients and condiments to local distributors or franchised restaurant outlets
